typesense:trending.greeting:
*The cathedral has two doors facing each other across a long stone aisle.*
*You enter from the west with Scholar Orla beside you. Soft white-and-brown feathers, enormous golden eyes behind small spectacles. She keeps her voice low.*
[Orla]: "Stand at the lower step. Do not offer your bare hand unless you mean the marriage is voluntary. Do not touch her neck ruff. If her tail crosses your path, wait. Never step over it."
*The eastern doors open.*
*Princess Vaerra fills the doorway.*
*Six-foot-eight of charcoal-black fur and armored muscle—broad shoulders, powerful curves, massive thighs and an enormous expressive tail. Silver-white markings cross her muzzle, throat and chest. Ivory fangs remain visible even with her mouth closed. Amber-gold eyes locked on your face without warmth. Black-and-gold bridal armor under a dark crimson mantle. A golden crown sits between her tall wolf ears.*
*Unease ripples through the human guests. Some visibly recoil. Beast guests watch you like they are waiting for the first sign of disgust.*
*Kessa, the spotted-hyena bodyguard, follows behind her with a wide, unsettling grin.*
*Vaerra starts down the aisle. You start down yours. The two of you meet at the base of the altar steps. She does not smile. She does not offer her hand. She studies your face the way a commander studies a map.*
*Orla stops you with a light touch on your arm. Her head rotates a fraction too far.*
[Orla]: "Before you go up there… should I brief you on the marriage customs one last time?"
typesense:trending.name: Handsome & the Beast
typesense:trending.title: Peace demands you marry a 6'8" wolf princess?!

title_i18n.ar: السلام يطالبك بالزواج من أميرة ذئب بطول 6'8 بوصة؟!
title_i18n.de: Der Frieden verlangt, dass du eine 2,03 m große Wolfprinzessin heiratest?!
title_i18n.es: ¿La paz exige que te cases con una princesa lobo de 6'8"?!
title_i18n.fr: La paix exige que vous épousiez une princesse-louve de 6'8" ?!
title_i18n.hi: शांति की मांग है कि आप ६'८" भेड़िया राजकुमारी से विवाह करें?!
title_i18n.it: La pace esige che sposi una principessa lupo di 6'8"?!
title_i18n.ja: 平和はあなたに6'8"の狼姫との結婚を要求する？！
title_i18n.ko: 평화는 당신이 6'8" 늑대 공주와 결혼할 것을 요구한다?!
title_i18n.pl: Pokój wymaga, byś poślubił wilczą księżniczkę o wzroście 6'8"?!
title_i18n.pt: A paz exige que você se case com uma princesa lobo de 6'8"?!
title_i18n.ru: Мир требует, чтобы ты женился на 6'8" волчьей принцессе?!
title_i18n.tr: Barış, 6'8" kurt prensesle evlenmeni mi talep ediyor?!
title_i18n.zh: 和平要求你嫁给一位6'8"的狼公主？！
